interpretation: IoU compares silhouettes after matching each image's figure height and bbox center. It cannot recover depth, anatomy, concavities, expression, or topology, and can be biased by perspective, shadows, pose, low panel resolution, or masks. The four separate ortho plates are the primary silhouette constraints; turnaround panel scores are secondary rotation consistency evidence.
